lines.en: My morning glow was definitely not glowing.
The purple tint is color correction. Violet helps balance yellow-looking dullness.
lines.or: ପର୍ପଲ ଟିଣ୍ଟ ମାନେ କଲର କରେକ୍ସନ, ହଳଦିଆ ଡଲନେସ୍ ବାଲାନ୍ସ କରେ।
lines.back_translation: Purple tint means colour correction, it balances yellowish dullness.

lines.en: It starts lavender, then blends completely clear.
Zero white cast, zero purple residue.
lines.or: ହ୍ୱାଇଟ କାଷ୍ଟ ଜିରୋ, ପର୍ପଲ ଦାଗ ଜିରୋ।
lines.back_translation: White cast zero, purple mark zero.

lines.en: It's made for Indian skin, with 4% niacinamide for a brighter-looking finish.
lines.or: ଇଣ୍ଡିଆନ ସ୍କିନ ପାଇଁ, ଚାରି ପର୍ସେଣ୍ଟ ନିଆସିନାମାଇଡରେ ବ୍ରାଇଟ ଫିନିଶ।
lines.back_translation: For Indian skin, a bright finish with four percent niacinamide.

lines.en: And SPF 50 PA+++ gives me the daily protection I actually need.
lines.or: ଆଉ ଏସପିଏଫ ଫିଫ୍ଟି, ପିଏ ଟ୍ରିପଲ ପ୍ଲସ, ଡେଲି ପ୍ରୋଟେକ୍ସନ, ଯାହା ମୋର ଦରକାର।
lines.back_translation: And SPF fifty, PA triple plus, daily protection, exactly what I need.
